description: Pure-DATA spec for a small finite-ring block-partition reversible QCA GNVW-index diagnostic. The engines compute the support-algebra transport index from conjugated local operator support near the oriented cut 3|4; this spec names the ring, alphabet, checkerboard partitions, rule families, and expected controls, but does not ship a computed support rank or result JSON.

operator_probe.support_algebra_index: For the cut 3|4, conjugate Pauli generators near the cut by U. For one-step controls use A_3 and A_4. For shift-by-k tests use the k-cell collar A_{3-k+1..3} and A_{4..4+k-1}, so additive transport across the cut cannot saturate at one crossed cell. The k-step shift diagnostic is oriented-local-cut flow: right_shift counts left-collar support crossing 3|4 to the right, and left_shift counts right-collar support crossing 3|4 to the left. The opposite ring cut is not subtracted into this local diagnostic. For non-shift controls, restrict left-source images to the right side and right-source images to the left side. Let r_R and r_L be the GF(2) ranks of those restricted Pauli vectors. The overlap algebra dimensions are 2^r_R and 2^r_L, and ind(U)=0.5*log(2^r_R/2^r_L). For qubits this equals 0.5*(r_R-r_L)*log(2).
operator_probe.not_shift_echo: The engines compute r_R and r_L from conjugated operator-support vectors on the periodic N=8 ring, not from a stored shift parameter or lifted open line.
operator_probe.same_operator_as_reversibility: The index and reversibility paths both consume N=8, even_bonds, odd_bonds, and the same shift_schedules. There is no POSITIONS=0..8 lifted support space.

chiral_shift_block_circuit.schedule_note: Each schedule is an adjacent-SWAP block circuit on true periodic ring bonds. Right and left chirality are produced by different ordered SWAP schedules, not by a sign flag.

non_shift_partitioned.block_gate: CNOT control-left-target-right on the periodic checkerboard bonds

ancestry.concept_summary: A finite ring of cells carries an even/odd checkerboard block structure. Reversible local block updates move information around the ring; the GNVW index is used here as the chirality probe for net transport around the ring.

lineage.F01: simultaneous-distinguishability surface -- the QCA step acts on the whole finite ring at once, and the GNVW index is the probe-relative invariant of net operator transport across the local cut.
lineage.N01: order/persistence -- U = U_odd o U_even is an ordered composition. The chirality, observed as the sign of the support-algebra index, is an order/orientation invariant of the ordered block sweep.
lineage.root_axiom: a = a iff a ~ b -- two QCAs are the same chirality class iff they are indistinguishable under the GNVW support-algebra index probe.
